questions.q: Who is Tanja drawing the series of forest animals for?
questions.e: In the video: "seriju ilustracija šumskih životinja koje on najviše voli" — a series of illustrations of forest animals that he loves the most.
In the video: "Inspiraciju za tu ilustraciju sam našla u ovoj knjizi" — I found the inspiration for that illustration in this book.

questions.q: What year is this edition of the book?
questions.e: In the video: "To je neko izdanje iz 1973. godine" — it's an edition from 1973.

questions.q: Why does Laza laugh on one page of the book?
o: A hare is hiding in a hollow
questions.e: In the video: "Laza se kikoće i smeje se što se taj zeka tu sakrio" — Laza giggles and laughs that the bunny hid there.

questions.q: What became the main problem with the first paper?
questions.e: In the video: "Jedan problem je što ovo nije papir za vodene boje" — one problem is that this is not watercolor paper.

questions.q: Why did the silhouettes of the trees bleed in the first attempt?
o: She didn't have the patience to wait for the paper to dry
questions.e: In the video: "nisam imala strpljenja" — I didn't have the patience.

questions.q: What paper did she choose for the third attempt?
questions.e: In the video: "kad sam videla da se onaj Baohong papir lepo ponaša u ilustraciji sa jazavcem" — when I saw that the Baohong paper behaves nicely in the illustration with the badger.

questions.q: What advice did the friend give after the photo?
o: Add more contrast and darken the hollow
questions.e: In the video: "samo daj malo više kontrasta, malo potamni tu šupljinu debla iza zeke" — just add a little more contrast, darken that hollow in the trunk behind the hare a bit.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.e: Strpljenje — patience.
Deblo — a tree trunk.
Krzno — fur, pelt.
Bubamara — a ladybug.
Istrajati — to hold out, not to give up.
Maslačak — a dandelion.
Pokvasiti — to wet, to moisten.
Drugarica — a girlfriend; dative plural: drugaricama.
A series of what? — genitive plural: šumskih životinja.
Od + genitive case: od tate.
With what? — instrumental case: hemijskom olovkom.
Opsednut + instrumental case: opsednut detelinom.

questions.q: Kad sam pokazala ___, svidelo mu se.
questions.e: Pokazati to whom? — dative case: Lazi.
Za + accusative case: za pejzaže — "for landscapes".

questions.q: bila sam nekako ___ kad sam je uradila.
questions.e: A woman is speaking (bila sam, uradila), so zadovoljna.

questions.q: ___ sam mu, oduševljen je, i meni je zbog toga jako drago.
questions.e: Showed once — perfective pokazati. Pokazivala is imperfective. A woman is speaking.
